_comment: view-agent-direct config. Copy to config.json and adapt. Secrets stay in files, never in this JSON.
_bind: A PRIVATE interface (loopback or VPN/WireGuard IP) — never a public one. Firewall the port to that network.
_self_url: Base URL under which the READER'S BROWSER reaches this agent (composes the /go links).
_token_file: Shared with the router: same value as OBSIDIAN_ROUTER_VIEW_AGENT_TOKEN. openssl rand -hex 24 > view-agent.token
_link_secret_file: HMAC secret for /go links. Absent: links are signed with the token. openssl rand -hex 24 > link.secret
_link_ttl_s: 0 = links in the chat history stay valid indefinitely. > 0 = /go answers 410 after that many seconds.
_navigate_on_view: true would make Obsidian jump to every note the router writes; false = navigate on click only.

detect._comment: Vaults ABSENT from "vaults" are classified from the router's /view hints (rest=<scheme://host:port>, obsidian_name=<label>). A "vaults" entry always wins. Needs token_file AND a signing secret. Anything unclassifiable is a 400 with the reason, never a guessed link.
detect._desktop_hosts: IPs, CIDRs or names of machines whose vaults are opened in the reader's DESKTOP Obsidian → obsidian-uri (the router must send obsidian_name). Empty = never.
detect._local_hosts: Extra names/IPs of THIS host as the router spells it. Loopback, bind and the self_url host are implied. A rest hint on this host → the ONE running container publishing that port → docker-exec.
detect._gui_container_ports: Container-side GUI port(s) (linuxserver/obsidian: 3001 = HTTPS). The host port publishing it becomes the redirect target.
detect._gui_url: {host} = host of the rest hint (the self_url host when that is loopback), {port} = published GUI port. Must be http(s)://{host}:{port} plus an optional path: no fixed host, no proxy.

alice._public_url: The GUI as the reader's browser sees it (e.g. Selkies). Redirect target after navigation.
alice._container: Real container name: deploy/preflight-direct.sh prints it.
alice._open_scheme: https when open_port is the Local REST API's TLS port (curl -k on the container's loopback).
alice._open_port: Local REST API insecurePort INSIDE the container (the preflight confirms it).
alice._alt_http: If the container runs with network_mode host, use open_mode http + open_url http://127.0.0.1:27180 instead (the bridge then sees 127.0.0.1).

bob-desktop._obsidian_vault: A vault served by the READER'S OWN desktop Obsidian (no web GUI): /go redirects to obsidian://open?vault=...&file=.... No public_url. Works only from the machine running that Obsidian.
